# Jose Perez Films

> Jose Perez is a documentary filmmaker and brand film director based in Valencia, Santa Clarita, California. He makes documentary style brand films, commercials, and documentaries for Santa Clarita and Los Angeles businesses, nonprofits, and brands. Currently booking new clients.

## What Jose makes
- Brand story films: founder and origin stories, culture and mission films, testimonials and case studies, event coverage.
- Brand commercials: 60 second ads to 5 minute films, product launch films, paid social ad creative, website hero films, agency and white label work.
- Documentaries: mini docs (5 to 15 minutes), feature documentaries for streaming and festivals, nonprofit and cause driven films.
- Ongoing content: monthly retainer packages through the Authority Content System.

## Where Jose works
Based in Valencia, Santa Clarita, CA. Serving the Santa Clarita Valley (Valencia, Newhall, Saugus, Canyon Country, Stevenson Ranch, Castaic) and Los Angeles. Available for projects across California.

## Background
15+ years behind the camera, since 2010. Director on every project, from strategy call to final color grade. Clients include UFC, Frontera Wines, Firefly Fabrication, and Alegria Publishing. Brand film turnaround is typically 2 to 4 weeks after the shoot.

## Documentary credits
- Feature documentary "The Life of Taurean Dorotae Lee," streaming on nine platforms including Tubi and Amazon Prime.
- Two films screened at Laemmle Theatres in Newhall, Santa Clarita.
- Worked on UFC documentaries streaming on Netflix and Paramount+.
- Short documentary on David Navas, connecting his car builds to his faith journey.
- Featured on Voyage LA.
